language.name: English
settings.title: Gaugely settings
settings.services.subtitle: Each provider can have two tracks: the subscription quota that fills up and resets, and API spending read with a key.
settings.services.vaultBanner: Keys are stored encrypted in Windows Credential Manager — never in settings.json
settings.note.anthropicOrg: Needs an organization in the Claude Console and an Admin key (sk-ant-admin…). Individual accounts have no Admin API.
settings.note.openaiSpend: Shows spending and token usage for the organization. OpenAI has no official prepaid balance to read.
settings.note.kimiPlatform: Needs a key from platform.kimi.ai. The Kimi Code key does not work here.
settings.note.geminiApi: Not available: Google does not report spending per API key. It is only visible through Cloud Billing.
settings.keys.label: {0} key
settings.keys.saveFailed: The key could not be saved to Windows Credential Manager.
settings.keys.removeFailed: The key could not be removed from Windows Credential Manager.
settings.tray.subtitle: What the icons next to the clock show.
settings.tray.groupHint: Shows the busiest limit of each service. Turn off to get one icon per limit.
settings.tray.richHint: A card with the service logo and its limits. Turn off for the plain Windows tooltip.
settings.tray.iconsHint: Choose which limits get an icon. The list comes from your accounts.
settings.tray.noData: Nothing read yet. The list fills in after the first successful reading.
settings.tray.rediscoverHint: On the next reading, every limit your accounts report is turned on again.
settings.widget.subtitle: A small always-on-top strip with the same numbers as the tray.
settings.widget.enabledHint: Click it to open the details; right-click for the menu.
settings.widget.modeHint: Floating sits in a corner. Notch docks flush against an edge of the screen.
settings.widget.handleHint: A small grip for moving the widget with the mouse.
settings.widget.itemsHint: Chosen separately from the tray icons.
settings.appearance.subtitle: Language, colors and the look of the icons.
settings.languageHint: Automatic follows the Windows display language.
settings.themeHint: Sets the icon colors and this window. Automatic follows Windows.
settings.color.derived: Warning and critical colors are derived from the service colors, so the palette stays consistent.
settings.color.shadeSpreadHint: How much the icons of one service differ in brightness.
settings.alerts.subtitle: When the numbers change color and when Windows notifies you.
settings.alerts.levelsHint: Applies to every service with a quota.
settings.notifyEnabled: Notify when a limit is crossed
settings.notifyHint: Once when a limit reaches this level; again only if it drops below and comes back.
settings.updates.subtitle: Gaugely never installs anything on its own — you always confirm.
settings.updates.autoHint: Looks for a new version on GitHub at most once a day, on start-up.
settings.updates.nowHint: To install, open About from the tray menu.
settings.updates.available: Version {0} is available. Open About from the tray menu to install it.
settings.conflict:
settings.json was changed outside Gaugely while this window was open.

Yes: save this window's settings over the file.
No: discard this window's changes and keep the file.
Cancel: go back to the window.
settings.advanced.subtitle: Timing and file details. Everything here is also in settings.json.
settings.refreshHint: Each service also has its own minimum gap, below.
settings.maxBackoffHint: After repeated failures, the wait doubles up to this limit.
settings.claude.autoRefreshHint: Normally Claude Code renews it. Turn on only if Claude Code stays closed for long periods.
settings.advanced.timingHint: Timeout: how long to wait for an answer. Interval: the minimum gap between two readings.
settings.advanced.jsonHint: Edits made in the file are picked up automatically. API keys are never stored in it.

about.tagline: AI subscription limits and API spending, live in the Windows tray.
